title: Automatic, offline and private time tracking. No cloud, no sign-up
excerpt: Threshyr records your workday on your own machine, sorts it into projects and clients, and tells you exactly what to invoice at the end of the month.
content_html:
Still curious?

The stuff you're probably wondering

Straight answers about privacy, automatic tracking, offline AI, and how Threshyr fits into your day.

What is Threshyr?

Threshyr is last time tracking app that you are going to use. It is intelligent, privacy-first, cheap, and offline desktop time tracker for Windows, and macOS. It runs quietly in the background, automatically categorizes the apps and websites you use, classifies your activity without manual timers or cloud dependencies.

Who is Threshyr built for?

Threshyr is designed for any one who is want to understand their computer usage, is in need of a personal time tracker that is not overpriced, desrie to be as productive as possible, and fed up with paying for monthly subscrpriotn SaaS products that are cloud dependent.

Who is the person behind Threshyr?

Threshyr is built by Affan Bajwa, a product designer and developer with over 8 years of experience building and designing software products. Holding a degree in Computer Science (BS-CS), Affan began his career as a .NET desktop application developer before transitioning into Graphic & UI/UX design, uniting technical systems engineering with user-first design craftsmanship.

Since starting his freelance career in 2016, Affan has contributed to taking numerous products from initial concept to active users including platforms like StockIntel, GovBuddy, EasyBMV, RareOS, TontineTrust, and Behtari. Beyond desktop and web applications, he has also developed and published mobile games as a creative hobby.

Throughout his freelance career, Affan tested virtually every time tracker available, yet each tool consistently fell short cluttered with manual timers, cloud dependencies, or overpriced monthly subscriptions. That firsthand frustration inspired him to build Threshyr: an effortless, offline, and privacy-respecting tracker designed to solve those exact problems.

What is the idea behind Threshyr?

Threhsyr is built because we all are tired of how modern software treats users. You shouldn't have to remember to click a timer every 20 minutes, create yet another account with a password you'll forget, or send confidential window titles to a remote cloud server. And you certainly shouldn't have to pay $10-$20 every single month—through busy quarters and slow rainy days alike just to see how you spent your time. Threshyr is local-first, runs silently in the background without logins, processes AI on-device without token fees, and charges a single fair yearly price. Simple, private, and built to last.

How does Threshyr’s yearly pricing work?

Threshyr is a single all-inclusive license priced at $29/year during our pre-release (50% off the standard $58/year). Every feature, priority support, and futures updates are included with no hidden fees or tiers.

Why is Threshyr cheaper than other timetrackers?

Threshyr is created based on the mission that not every thing has to be a monthly subsription, not everything has to be on cloud, and the benefits of AI worflows should be passed on to the users also. These direct structural savings should be passed on to the users instead of marking up monthly software subscriptions.

Why doesn't Threshyr offer a monthly subscription?

These are uncertain times and more uncertimes are ahead. Threshyr eliminates monthly subscriptions to free you from recurring subscription fatigue. A single, transparent yearly plan keeps our incentives aligned with building long-term software quality rather than locking you into endless monthly micro-transactions.

What makes Threshyr better compared to other time trackers?

Others trackers come up with corporate employee surveillance, cloud-dependent SaaS pricing, overprice monthly subsriptions that keep going up, manual start and stop timer, multiple tier pricing with essential features locked in high tiers, credit based expensive AI features and much more. But Threshyr is built exclusively for personal productivity. You get zero manual timers, fully offline light weight on-device AI activity classification engine, 100% private data that never leaves your machine, and no monthly subscription fatigue.

Where is my data stored if Threshyr doesn't use the cloud?

Your data is stored exclusively on your local computer in a fast, private SQLite database. Threshyr is 100% local-first — there are no remote servers, no cloud backups, and no external syncing. Your time tracking data stays entirely on your drive and never leaves your machine.

Does Threshyr track my activity or collect background telemetry?

No. Threshyr never tracks your workflow, user behavior, or application activity. The desktop app records no keystrokes, captures no screenshots, logs no document titles to the cloud, and contains zero behavioral analytics. The only background signal is an anonymous daily ping used solely to check for app updates.

Do I need to create an account or provide an email to use Threshyr?

No. Threshyr requires zero accounts, passwords, or email registrations. You simply download, install, and start tracking immediately. There are no logins to manage, no email spam, and your usage remains completely anonymous.

How accurate is project time tracking in Threshyr?

Threshyr provides pinpoint accuracy by combining deterministic keyword rules (matching specific app window titles) with smart app categorization. Shared applications like VS Code or browser tabs split cleanly between client projects with second-by-second precision, and idle detection automatically pauses when you step away.

How does Threshyr’s AI categorize time completely offline?

Threshyr uses lightweight, on-device machine learning model that execute directly on your local CPU and GPU. Unlike cloud AI tools that transmit your window titles and private project names to external servers, Threshyr categorizes your workflow locally with zero latency, zero cloud costs, and zero data leakage.

How does automatic categorization and project tagging work?

Threshyr ships with a built-in offline dictionary of thousands of desktop apps and websites, instantly tagging roughly 90% of your workflow as Productive, Neutral, or Unproductive. You can also create custom keyword rules (e.g., "if window title contains Thesis, assign to Project Writing") to automatically organize work into specific client buckets.

Which browsers can Threshyr track activity in?

Threshyr tracks active URLs and domain-level activity across Google Chrome, Brave, Apple Safari, and Microsoft Edge on both Windows and macOS.

Mozilla Firefox is currently not supported due to technical differences in how it exposes active tab information to desktop accessibility APIs. Firefox support is planned for a future update.

How does automatic tracking work without manual start/stop timers?

Threshyr runs quietly in your operating system background, automatically logging active window titles and application switches as you work. When you step away from your computer, it automatically detects idle time and pauses tracking, eliminating the stress of remembering to start or stop a timer.

Can I manually adjust or fix activity that was categorized incorrectly?

Yes. If an activity is categorized incorrectly, you can reclassify it with a single click. Threshyr saves your preference locally and applies it to future sessions, continuously personalizing its accuracy to your specific workflow.

是的。 If an activity is categorized incorrectly, you can reclassify it with a single click. Threshyr saves your preference locally and applies it to future sessions, continuously personalizing its accuracy to your specific workflow.
